The *Piṭṭhiduka* (Patthana 2.13) is a section of the *Paṭṭhāna*, the seventh and concluding book of the Abhidhamma Piṭaka in the Theravāda Tipiṭaka. Within the canonical structural design of the *Paṭṭhāna*, it constitutes the final dyadic section (duka) of the Duka-paṭṭhāna, examining the application of the twenty-four conditional relations to the supplementary pairs (piṭṭhiduka) of the Abhidhamma matrix.
